supporting_pages.title: Maintenance overview \_|\_ AlloyDB for PostgreSQL \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: Reasons for maintenance Periodic maintenance updates can happen for the following reasons: New AlloyDB features and bug fixes: to launch new features, Google must update the AlloyDB software that runs on the nodes within your cluster.

Non-emergency maintenance for an AlloyDB cluster with no configured maintenance windows can occur any time except for the hours between 6 AM and 10 PM on weekdays, in the local time of the region where the cluster is located.
You can set maintenance windows for both primary and secondary AlloyDB clusters.
